name: io.github.SWATGenX/swatgenx
description: Watershed modeling for the conterminous United States. Search calibrated SWAT+ models, read calibration and held-out validation scores, query a national groundwater lithology inventory of 28.8 million depth intervals and a national PFAS monitoring inventory, and order and download SWAT+ watershed models built from NHDPlus HR hydrography and national datasets.
